question: Who is the author of Natyashastra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatmuni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharatmuni** is traditionally considered the author of the ancient Indian treatise on performing arts called the **Natyashastra**.
 
• The **Natyashastra** is a comprehensive text on ancient Indian dramaturgy, covering theatre, dance, and music.
 
• It is believed to have been written between 200 BCE
